benchmark.name: NYC Metadata-Aware Text-to-Spark-SQL Benchmark
benchmark.description: Controlled benchmark for comparing Full Catalog, Relation-Aware Retrieval, and Relation-Aware Retrieval with validation and one-shot repair.

queries.question: What was the average trip distance for Yellow Taxi trips in January 2024? Return exactly one column named average_trip_distance.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(trip_distance) AS average_trip_distance FROM yellow_taxi

queries.question: How many Green Taxi trips had a trip distance greater than 10 miles in January 2024? Return exactly one column named trip_count.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM green_taxi WHERE trip_distance > 10

queries.question: Which pickup taxi zone had the highest number of Yellow Taxi trips in January 2024? Return exactly two columns named zone_name and trip_count, with only the top zone.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT z.Zone AS zone_name, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM yellow_taxi y JOIN taxi_zones z ON y.PULocationID = z.LocationID GROUP BY z.Zone ORDER BY trip_count DESC, zone_name ASC LIMIT 1

queries.question: Which borough received the most Green Taxi dropoffs in January 2024? Return exactly two columns named borough and trip_count, with only the top borough.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT z.Borough AS borough, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM green_taxi g JOIN taxi_zones z ON g.DOLocationID = z.LocationID GROUP BY z.Borough ORDER BY trip_count DESC, borough ASC LIMIT 1

queries.question: Compare the average trip distance of Yellow Taxi and Green Taxi trips in January 2024. Return exactly two columns named taxi_type and average_trip_distance, with one row for Yellow and one row for Green.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT 'Yellow' AS taxi_type, AVG(trip_distance) AS average_trip_distance FROM yellow_taxi UNION ALL SELECT 'Green' AS taxi_type, AVG(trip_distance) AS average_trip_distance FROM green_taxi

queries.question: What was the average trip distance for Yellow Taxi trips during rainy hours in January 2024? Return exactly one column named average_trip_distance.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(y.trip_distance) AS average_trip_distance FROM yellow_taxi y JOIN weather_hourly w ON date_trunc('hour', y.tpep_pickup_datetime) = w.weather_hour WHERE w.has_precipitation = TRUE

queries.question: How many Green Taxi trips started during dry hours in January 2024? Return exactly one column named trip_count.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM green_taxi g JOIN weather_hourly w ON date_trunc('hour', g.lpep_pickup_datetime) = w.weather_hour WHERE w.has_precipitation = FALSE

queries.question: Which pickup borough had the most Yellow Taxi trips during rainy hours in January 2024? Return exactly two columns named borough and trip_count, with only the top borough.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT z.Borough AS borough, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM yellow_taxi y JOIN taxi_zones z ON y.PULocationID = z.LocationID JOIN weather_hourly w ON date_trunc('hour', y.tpep_pickup_datetime) = w.weather_hour WHERE w.has_precipitation = TRUE GROUP BY z.Borough ORDER BY trip_count DESC, borough ASC LIMIT 1

queries.question: What was the average temperature during rainy hours in January 2024? Return exactly one column named average_temperature_f.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(temperature_f) AS average_temperature_f FROM weather_hourly WHERE has_precipitation = TRUE

queries.question: During rainy hours in January 2024, which clock hour of day had the most Yellow Taxi pickups? Return exactly two columns named hour_of_day and trip_count, with only the top hour.
queries.gold_sql: SELECT hour(y.tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour_of_day, COUNT(*) AS trip_count FROM yellow_taxi y JOIN weather_hourly w ON date_trunc('hour', y.tpep_pickup_datetime) = w.weather_hour WHERE w.has_precipitation = TRUE GROUP BY hour(y.tpep_pickup_datetime) ORDER BY trip_count DESC, hour_of_day ASC LIMIT 1
